# PenEcho scene vendors

Pinned, unmodified MIT builds used by `public/scene-runtime.js` inside
sandboxed Widgets. PenEcho's own integration stays AGPL-3.0-only; these files
keep their MIT licenses (see the `*.LICENSE` files and NOTICE).
